newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA TIE UP FIGO, DE LA PENA AND LUIS ENRIQUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA TIE UP FIGO, DE LA PENA AND LUIS ENRIQUE.

text.p: With the future of Brazilian star Ronaldo still in the balance, Barcelona on Friday moved to secure the service of three key players until well into the next century.
Luis Figo, Luis Enrique Martinez and Ivan de la Pena have each been given lucrative, extended contracts.
De la Pena will earn an estimated 275 million pesetas ($1.9 million) a year, with the other two players not far behind. All three had received offers from foreign clubs.

Included in the contracts are some of the highest 'withdrawal clauses' on record. To buy de la Pena a rival club would have to pay 10 billion pesetas ($69 million), and half that amount to sign either Figo or Luis Enrique.
